body:
Bumps the cargo group with 3 updates in the /rust directory: [lino-objects-codec](https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-objects-codec), [formatjs_icu_messageformat](https://github.com/formatjs/formatjs) and [syn](https://github.com/dtolnay/syn). Updates `lino-objects-codec` from 0.8.0 to 0.9.2
Release notes

Sourced from lino-objects-codec's releases.

[JavaScript] 0.9.2

CI: the changeset check now counts only changesets added by the pull request, so a changeset still pending on main no longer fails unrelated PRs or satisfies a PR that adds none. Dependabot PRs are exempt and get a notice instead of a false failure.

Related Pull Request: #72

[Rust] 0.9.2

Changed

  • Update links-notation from 0.25.2 to 0.27.1, the latest release (0.26.0 included), so a project that also depends on the current parser resolves one copy instead of two (issue #74). No public API changes: no links-notation type is part of this crate's API, and the test suite passes unchanged against 0.25.2, 0.26.0 and 0.27.1.

Changed

  • Releases now publish to crates.io through trusted publishing (OIDC, rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action) first, falling back to the CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN / CARGO_TOKEN secret only when no trusted publisher is registered. The publish step names which credential it used and, on failure, points to the crate's Trusted Publishing settings (issue #73).

[JavaScript] 0.9.1

Decode large readable documents without whole-document character arrays. Use string slices for quoted values and bounded strict UTF-8 processing for escaped payloads, preserving Unicode and legacy quote behavior. Refresh dependencies required by freshness CI.

Related Pull Request: #70

[Rust] 0.9.1

Changed

  • Raised the serde_json floor to 1.0.154 (and refreshed Cargo.lock) so the Dependency Freshness gate passes again.
  • CI: Dependabot pull requests are exempt from the changelog fragment check (decided from the PR author, not the branch name), so grouped dependency updates no longer fail it and get merged red.

[JavaScript] 0.9.0

Expose single-line and verbatim value formatters. Preserve a one-null array on a single-line round trip. Update links-notation to 0.23.0, refresh all direct and transitive dependencies, and check freshness in CI.

Related Pull Request: #66

[Rust] 0.9.0
